title: Semos Villagers Job Fix
description: Display jobs outfits for my villagers packs on 1.21.9+
body:
### <font color="#f02222">!!! This pack is heavy on performances.</font> For now I have sadly no other solution

This pack fix the lack of job display of my villagers pack on 1.21.9 and up [**[**<font color="#008000">**Hermitcraft Villagers**</font>**]**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hermitcraft-villagers), [**[**<font color="#008000">**Songs Of War Villagers**</font>**]**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/songs-of-war-villagers) and [**[**<font color="#008000">**Alex and Steve Villagers**</font>**]**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alex-and-steve-villagers)

Require version 3.0.4 minimum of Hermitcraft and Songs of War and 6.0.4 of Alex and Steve  
Keep track of what versions of my packs are compatible with wich addon version with this file: [[<font color="#daa520">with this link</font>](https://1drv.ms/x/c/5017ea34619ff0f9/EYARtfWSbd1IsoYWCn7M-CkBHKTpT6MVfBMwl93LenDkAg?e=dbVTA0)]  
The pack order has no importance  
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50b3a965442c94f867d26a128f7f52f6b7114aa5.png)

# <font color="#daa520">Compatibility:</font>

- This pack uses the vanilla location of the textures and therefore should be compatible with any ressource pack that change or variate those.
- Compatible with my [biome fix pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/semos-villagers-biome-fix)
![job + biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/408fb1e71ee314b4c9f907e8cf5c2e3e221e486f.png)
  
# <font color="#daa520">Advanced Control:</font>

You can toggle the visibility of the profession texture for each entity by putting one of the following in their name:  
```no profession``` ```body profession``` ```left arm profession``` ```right arm profession``` ```head profession``` ```right leg profession``` ```left leg profession```  
```no level``` ```body level```

# <font color="#daa520">Qwerks:</font>

- Head textures are resized to match the player head. So they're mixels.
- Depending of the player face, head equipement like glasses can be far away from the eyes and look funny
- Same goes for the hats
- If the job level texture adds something to another part of the body. It will not show up in my villagers pack. This is to gain a little bit of performances
